dedupe_keys.name: d 2epc bim based digital twin data model example and real time measurements certh nzeb smart house

description: This dataset is an example building digital twin from the H2020 project D^2EPC, which developed dynamic, digital-twin-based energy performance certificates. It was published on 9 October 2023 by the Centre for Research and Technology Hellas (CERTH) and corresponds to the first of the project's six case studies, the CERTH nearly-zero-energy Smart House. It contains the BIM-based data model of the building's parameters as JSON, and real-time measurements collected during the project: carbon dioxide, temperature, humidity, light, presence, fine particles, volatile organic compounds, noise and smoke in the living room; temperature, humidity, light and presence in the office; HVAC electricity use of each floor; whole-building electricity for lighting and appliances; and output of the photovoltaic system. Coverage is one research house. Access: a JSON model and a zip of measurement files (about 3 MB) on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: a single, highly instrumented building, and the measurement period is not stated in the record. Simulation uses are testing digital-twin data models and dynamic energy certification, and calibrating building energy models. Related records: the crossCert EPC benchmark buildings and the BIM4EEB sensor datasets.
